item.title: Daily digest — 2026-08-04
item.description:
It's been an exciting week across our open-source research tools, with multiple projects seeing significant updates. The `tenzing` and `scrutiny` projects both received updates to their `gh-pages` branches, with `tenzing` building its site for version 0.4.1 and `scrutiny` deploying to `gh-pages` twice, indicating a release or deployment. Meanwhile, `oddpub` added functionality to its ontogenerator for detecting "nature das and cas", and `docpluck` saw a range of updates, including the addition of a hard rule to survey the corpus before writing a threshold and fixes to various modules. Notably, `escicheck` synced changes from `escicheckapp` to bring its `main` branch up to date with the latest versions of `effectcheck`. These updates demonstrate the connections and collaborations between our projects, and we celebrate the progress being made across the community.

55 commits across 7 active repositories this week.

New releases: auto-zcurve v0.11.2

Dormant repos revived: scrutiny, escicheck

Most active:

docpluck22 commits
coarse14 commits
auto-zcurve10 commits
scrutiny4 commits
metacheck2 commits

item.title: docpluck: 21 commits today
item.description:
giladfeldman/docpluck

Work was done on the 'main' branch, where a hard rule was added to survey the corpus before writing a threshold in the "docpluck-iterate" process. The "docs(findings)" section was updated multiple times, including the testing and rejection of four geometric chain-merge discriminators, the evaluation of distinct_y threshold, and the reporting of a P0r table-author-cell regression by CitationGuard. Fixes were applied to various modules, including "tables" and "normalize", to address issues such as grid-guard false negatives, ReDoS, and table caption handling, with specific version updates including v2.4.119, v2.4.120, and v2.4.121. Additionally, tests were pinned for issues like the "_cluster_into_rows" chain-merge defect and the "maier T7 TEXT-LOSS" problem, and documentation was updated for handoffs, triage, and todo items, including the closure of R-0072 and the release of v2.4.118.

21 commit(s) today:

  • 94f3def [main] docpluck-iterate: add hard rule 20 — survey the corpus before writing a threshold — Gilad Feldman
  • a7c7d6f [main] docs(findings): 4 geometric chain-merge discriminators tested and rejected; period-aware column overlap is the best candidate but still unsafe — Gilad Feldman
  • b813adc [main] docs(findings): chain-merge scope is wider; distinct_y threshold tested and REJECTED — Gilad Feldman
  • a51c894 [main] fix(tables,normalize): grid-guard false negatives + a 50x ReDoS (v2.4.121) — Gilad Feldman
  • f510984 [main] fix(docpluck-qa): re-point 6 reference procedures off the dead Dropbox root — Gilad Feldman
  • 80979d3 [main] docs(findings): CitationGuard reports a P0r table-author-cell regression + an AMD header splice — Gilad Feldman
  • b0a97cc [main] test(tables): pin maier T7 TEXT-LOSS — prose grid outranks the correct data — Gilad Feldman
  • 672177a [main] test(tables): pin the _cluster_into_rows chain-merge defect (attempted fix REVERTED) — Gilad Feldman
  • 9fde274 [main] docs(triage): correct the RC-T whitespace root cause — caption guard, not prose guard — Gilad Feldman
  • ea4eb1e [main] fix(tables): a table's own caption no longer condemns its own table (v2.4.120) — Gilad Feldman
  • adb52b0 [main] docs(handoff): run-4 session close — v2.4.119 shipped; RC-T cycles 4-6 + gold-queue handoffs — Gilad Feldman
  • 89fc6d5 [main] fix(tables): RC-T caption-tail walk — tables no longer drop their first rows (v2.4.119) — Gilad Feldman
  • b5382ac [main] docs(todo): close R-0072 as verified false transfer — Gilad Feldman
  • 9985519 [main] fix(harness): skip only when the prior extraction matches the RUNNING library version (R-0004) — Gilad Feldman
  • 4daea57 [main] docpluck-review: add universal-quantifier spot-check hard rule — Gilad Feldman
  • d769554 [main] docs(triage+handoff): run-4 close — W0n shipped (v2.4.118); maier η²p adjudicated OCR-tier; punch-list current — Gilad Feldman
  • e7d7e47 [main] release(glyph): W0n p-threshold dropped-decimal recovery — v2.4.118 — Gilad Feldman
